title: Hinomori Shiho — Happy Birthday!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That just leaves the invitations I still need to write for everyone...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Sh-Shii?!
Oh no! I need to cover everything on my desk...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, you're here.
I've been trying to get your attention for a while now, but I just came to let you know that it's your turn to take a bath.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Also, why's your desk such a mess? Are you working on something for your stream...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Y-Yes, I am! Sorry, Shii.
I'll take my bath in a little bit.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Suit yourself... Hm?
Hey, Shizuku, you dropped a sheet of paper.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I was hoping to discuss it with you after I had a chance to figure out some details, but now that you know...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Remember how you used to invite Honami and the others over each year to celebrate your birthday?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The moon viewing party we had with Airi and everyone else was really a lot of fun, so I was wondering if you'd like it if we threw something like that...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I won't stop you.
I mean, you've already started working on it, right?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Shii...!
Thank you so much! I promise to make it as wonderful a birthday party as I can!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Alright, alright, I get it.
Now, go take your bath.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Good morning, Shiho!
Oh, Shizuku just stopped by earlier!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah, she brought us these.
Invitations for your birthday party!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But are you sure? I mean, I'm really just another classmate...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I don't see a problem since you'll have Minori there with you. Also, I'm pretty sure she's inviting Ichika and the others as well.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Okay! Thanks, Shiho.
I'll make sure to get you something good!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (When's the last time I had a birthday party like this... Come to think of it, Shizuku used to celebrate with her friends...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (In retrospect, I feel like I should've made a bigger deal out of her birthday...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, this is so cute! A pass case in the shape of a sparrow! I was just thinking about getting a new one too!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You mentioned it during dinner the other day, remember? The one you have right now is starting to come apart, right...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I'm glad she liked it, but that present was all I really did for her...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Alright, we're a day early but...
Happy birthday, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Thank you too, KAITO.
I know parties aren't really your thing.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, but your special day only comes once a year so...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
He's right!
You're having a party tomorrow to celebrate too, right? You should be having as much fun as you can!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, she's going through the trouble of throwing a party for me, so I will...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Um, Luka?
Is it me or does Shiho seem a little down today...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, I noticed that as well.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm gonna stay to practice a little more, so I'll see you tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Get ready for a really amazing birthday present, okay♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, okay. Keep in mind that you'll be too excited to sleep tonight if you get all worked up about it now.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Let's all make sure not to oversleep tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
It's your birthday tomorrow, isn't it?
Why the long face? Is something bothering you?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, not really... I was just going over some things we went over during practice today.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Are you sure about that, Shiho...?
You can always ask us if something is bothering you.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We just want you to wholeheartedly enjoy your birthday. Why not take this opportunity to discuss what's on your mind?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So you feel a little guilty about your sister putting a whole party together for you compared to the present you gave her on her birthday...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: In hindsight, I can't help but wonder if I should've thrown one for her considering how many more friends she has than me...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Shiho...
Everybody has their own way of celebrating or showing appreciation for someone.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Only one thing matters in the end.
Whether or not you genuinely “want to celebrate” them.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Whether or not that feeling's genuine...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. And if it still bothers you, why not ask your sister yourself?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Right. You should enjoy the party she's throwing for you, so I recommend doing so as well.
